owner_calls.question: G2: in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3 (episodes 17-20) Hive infects Daisy and she serves him (kills Malick, steals the Kree Beacon and Terrigen crystals, joins 'Hive's team' to kidnap Radcliffe) until she is freed and returns to S.H.I.E.L.D.; Coulson also disbands the Secret Warriors in episode 17. Brainwashed service counts, but the screen never names Hive's faction after he breaks from HYDRA, and the dataset files Hive himself under HYDRA. Add a stage for it, and under what name?
options: Keep as is (Secret Warriors S3, then Independent S3, left S3)
Add ['HYDRA','Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3'] (the dataset's name for Hive's group) then ['S.H.I.E.L.D.','Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3'] before Independent S3
Add a new name for Hive's followers (owner to choose) then S.H.I.E.L.D. S3 before Independent S3
owner_calls.evidence: Episode 17: Hive infects Daisy at the Schoonebeek HYDRA base; she kills Malick, frames Lincoln, steals the Kree Beacon and goes back to Hive. Coulson tells her he disbands the Secret Warriors. Episode 18: she goes with Hive's team to Bucharest to kidnap Radcliffe. Episode 20: she is freed. End of S3: she has left S.H.I.E.L.D. and is the vigilante Quake (the record already has this).

owner_calls.question: G2/G3: at the end of Dark Phoenix Xavier retires as dean (the school is renamed for Jean, Hank takes over) and he leaves for Paris. Retiring is a move under the rules, but the record's next step, Deadpool 2, glimpses him with the X-Men at the mansion (the owner already said that glimpse doesn't move his Earth). Record the retirement?
options: Keep as is (The X-Men last, no left)
Add ['Independent','Dark Phoenix'] and left 'Dark Phoenix', then ['The X-Men','Deadpool 2'] for the glimpse
Add ['Independent','Dark Phoenix'] and left 'Dark Phoenix', nothing for Deadpool 2
owner_calls.evidence: Dark Phoenix: 'Xavier's school is renamed the Jean Grey School for Gifted Youngsters and Xavier retires as dean, with McCoy taking his place.' He then meets Erik at a cafe in Paris. Deadpool 2: McAvoy's Xavier is glimpsed with the young X-Men in a room at the mansion.

owner_calls.question: V1/G2: this record is a couple (Dale and Stacey Yorkes), and in Runaways S3 they part: Dale alone joins Leslie's re-formed Church of Gibborim (he lives in a tent on its compound among the parishioners) while Stacey is still possessed, then both rejoin the PRIDE that Geoffrey reassembles. Record Dale's Church stint on the shared record (or split it)?
options: Keep as is (Synnergy, then The Pride)
Add ['The Church of Gibborim','Runaways S3'] then ['The Pride','Runaways S3'] (true of Dale only)
Split the record into Dale and Stacey
owner_calls.evidence: Runaways S3 episode 6: Dale has returned to Los Angeles and lives on the Church of Gibborim's compound; Molly visits him there. Episodes 7-8: the coven takes him captive; Cloak frees him, Stacey and Victor. Episode 9: Geoffrey reassembles PRIDE and Dale rejoins. The Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki lists the Church of Gibborim (formerly) for Dale but not for Stacey.
